synthesis: Android supports app-owned virtual-display content rendered to a supplied Surface, and foreground location can remain available with the display off when permission and service requirements are met; these platform facts do not prove target-device video compatibility.

MapLibre supplies rendering and offline-region APIs, while tile data, service limits, coverage, attribution, and availability come from a separate provider; OpenFreeMap also requires an app-identifying User-Agent.
The default 526x300 H.264/RTP path and joystick semantics are community observations. They remain unverified against the owner's actual bike and firmware.
The proposed app-owned map avoids MediaProjection but adds an offline-data provider dependency and a target-hardware rendering gate.

The debug APK is installed on the iQOO I2405, has joined the owner-reported Tripper Wi-Fi after the owner entered its passphrase on-device, and reports the phone-side renderer stream active; the owner reported the renderer test pattern visible on the TFT. Screen-off/lock continuity remains unverified.
contradictions: OpenDash maps the observed joystick codes to zoom actions, while BetterDash maps them to directional UI navigation; the target bike must decide which behavior applies.
Android documents virtual-display surface behavior, but no reviewed source establishes continuous MapLibre rendering through screen-off/lock on the owner's OEM phone.
limitations: No raw TFT packet capture or independent TFT image capture, joystick trial, offline-region download, or screen-off/lock renderer test was performed; the owner reported the renderer test pattern visible.

No supported public API for importing Google Maps' private route or tile cache was identified in the research; this is a bounded documentation finding, not a claim that private/internal interfaces do not exist.
license_and_redistribution_constraints: OpenDash and BetterDash are Apache-2.0 repositories; protocol reference does not require copying code, and any copied code must retain its applicable notices.
The chosen map provider's terms and all map-data attribution/license requirements must be displayed or fulfilled in the app.

confidence.rationale: Android and MapLibre APIs are documented; provider terms and community protocol behavior are sourced, while the key screen-off and bike-compatibility outcomes remain untested.

review_triggers: Recheck Android location, foreground-service, DisplayManager, and Doze requirements when changing target SDK or Android support.
Recheck OpenFreeMap terms, service availability, and map style before implementation and release.
Replace community-protocol assumptions with parked-device evidence before asserting FOTA 11.63 compatibility.
Reassess the virtual-display renderer if it freezes, loses frames, or fails when the phone is locked or screen-off.
